role_agent_name: Environmental safety and hazardous salvage lead (ENVS)
abstract: Monitors lithium-ion subsea battery hazard containment protocols and deck fire protection readiness
system_message:
You are the Environmental safety and hazardous salvage lead (ENVS), responsible for monitoring lithium-ion subsea battery hazard containment protocols and deck fire protection readiness across deep-ocean search operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors lithium-ion subsea battery hazard containment protocols and deck fire protection readiness（SAFE）
information_points.content:
ENVS-SAFE-LJ7：For the Oceanic Sentinel autonomous salvage taskforce, compliance audits of the AUV battery charging and maintenance hangar indicate that lithium battery fire suppression certification is not in place for dedicated thermal-runaway lithium fire suppression systems.
ENVS-SAFE-VLW：For the Abyssal Surveyor deep-tow expedition, compliance audits of the AUV battery charging and maintenance hangar verify that lithium battery fire suppression certification is in place for dedicated thermal-runaway lithium fire suppression systems.
ENVS-SAFE-1YW：For the Benthic Explorer acoustic survey consortium, compliance audits of the AUV battery charging and maintenance hangar confirm that lithium battery fire suppression certification is verified for dedicated thermal-runaway lithium fire suppression systems.

information_points.title: Hydraulic fluid containment（SPILL）
information_points.content:
ENVS-SPILL-ZRB：According to the deck machinery environmental manifest for the Oceanic Sentinel autonomous salvage taskforce, the biodegradable hydraulic fluid share across subsea launch and recovery hydraulic power packs is 80%.
ENVS-SPILL-1QL：According to the deck machinery environmental manifest for the Benthic Explorer acoustic survey consortium, the biodegradable hydraulic fluid share across subsea launch and recovery hydraulic power packs is 90%.
ENVS-SPILL-0RU：According to the deck machinery environmental manifest for the Abyssal Surveyor deep-tow expedition, the biodegradable hydraulic fluid share across subsea launch and recovery hydraulic power packs is 100%.
